title: Trendlines and levels
goal: Draw a trendline and a flat price line on a real chart.

objectives.text: Draw a trendline through two lows or highs.
Say what a flat line is for.
Draw a flat line at a price.
Use magnet mode to snap to a candle.

slides.text: A trendline is a line through the lows or the highs of a chart. It shows which way the price leans.
slides.title: The trendline

demo.caption: Real Apple prices. The lows climb. A line under them leans up.

slides.text: Pick the trendline tool in the toolbar. Click on one low. Then click on a later low.
slides.title: How to draw one

slides.text: A horizontal line is a flat line at one price. Use it to mark a price.
slides.title: The flat line

slides.text: Magnet mode snaps clicks to a candle price. It keeps your lines neat.
slides.title: Magnet mode

slides.text: Lines are your own guesses. Two people can draw them in two ways. No line can tell what is next.
slides.title: Lines are guesses

questions.explanation: A trendline runs through the lows, or the highs, of a chart.
Yes. It stays at one price all the way across.

questions.prompt: What is a flat line at one price good for?
questions.explanation: It marks a price. You see when the chart comes back to it.

questions.prompt: A trendline can tell you what the price will do next.
questions.explanation: No. A trendline shows the past. It cannot say what is next.
Magnet mode pulls clicks to a candle price.

questions.prompt: Draw a flat line at the lowest price on the chart.
questions.explanation: Its low is the bottom price on the chart. A flat line there marks the low.

questions.prompt: Draw a flat line at the highest price on the chart.
questions.explanation: The highest price is the top of the tall spike. A flat line there marks the high.

questions.prompt: Draw a trendline on the lows. Start at candle 5. End at candle 29.
questions.explanation: Both candles are low spots on the way up. A line through them leans up.

questions.prompt: Draw a trendline on the highs. Start at candle 1. End at candle 30.
questions.explanation: These two highs sit far apart. A line through them leans down.
